=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/guard_differential.py:318-327 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: `hook_env` passes unprefixed caller environment variables to the hook subprocess.
  WHY: The hooks do not read those variables today, and the test suite verifies no token or kill switch leaks, so the reviewer reports no runtime failure.
- .github/workflows/ci.yml:488-510 | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The inline script does not validate that `pull_request` in the event payload is a dictionary before reading the PR body.
  WHY: A malformed payload results in an empty body treated like a PR without an Intended loosening section, which the reviewer reports is harmless.
- scripts/guard_differential.py: `intentional_loosening` parser, the no-backtick branch (`else: hook, shape = "", content.strip()`) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A hook-prefixed list item without backticks is parsed with the hook prefix included in the shape rather than as the hook name.
  WHY: An intended loosening in that form will not match the corpus shape, so the check still fails until the line is rewritten.
- scripts/guard_differential.py: `compare_hook_dirs` building a fresh scenario per shape (`root = scratch / f"{hook}-{index}-{side}"`) and `_init_repo` running per scenario | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: `compare_hook_dirs` creates a fresh scenario and runs `_init_repo` for every shape on both sides, without sharing work across shapes.
  WHY: Against the shipped corpora, the reviewer estimates roughly 360 `_init_repo` calls per tree and warns that the check may exceed the 20-minute CI job budget.
- scripts/guard_differential.py: `run_hook` (subprocess.run block, ~line 469-478)
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Strict text decoding in `subprocess.run` can raise `UnicodeDecodeError` if a hook emits non-UTF-8 output.
  WHY: The exception propagates and aborts the entire `compare_hook_dirs` run for that tree instead of producing an error outcome for that shape.
- scripts/guard_differential.py: `compare_hook_dirs` scenario creation loop (~line 542-556)
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An exception from running a single shape is not caught within the scenario loop.
  WHY: A subprocess launch or scratch-directory I/O failure aborts the whole comparison for that tree and hides partial results from the other corpora.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
